plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: Genetics (BS). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] Must make a grade of C or better.
[grid1 fn2] To be selected from the University Core Curriculum. Of the 21 hours shown as University Core Curriculum electives, 3 hours must be from language, philosophy and culture, 3 hours from creative arts, 3 hours from social and behavioral sciences, 6 hours from American history, 6 hours from POLS 206 and POLS 207 . The graduation requirements include a requirement for 3 hours of International and Cultural Diversity courses and 3 hours of Cultural Discourse courses which may be met by courses satisfying the language, philosophy and culture, creative arts, social and behavioral sciences, government/political science and American history requirements if they are also on the approved list of international and cultural diversity courses.
[grid1 fn3] Select from any 100-499 that is not used elsewhere (except BICH 303 , BICH 410 , BICH 411 , BICH 412 , BICH 440 , BICH 441 ; MATH 100-104, MATH 130-148; STAT 201 ). Often used for a minor. Students intending to pursue an advance degree in Genetics are strongly urged to use some general electives for additional upper division courses in Biochemistry, Genetics, Biology, Chemistry, Mathematics or Statistics.
[grid1 fn4] To fulfill the disciplinary focus requirement, students must complete one of the following options: (i) take 4 credits of GENE 491 , with at least 1 credit designated as writing-intensive (W); (ii) take 1 credit of GENE 491 as a writing-intensive (W) course and 3 additional credits from a combination of GENE 485 and GENE 491 ; or (iii) take an additional 2-credit lab course, either GENE 432/BICH 432 or BICH 414 , and 2 additional credits of approved directed electives.
[grid1 fn5] With approval of student's academic advisor select from GENE 400-499. BICH 409 , BICH 410 , BICH 411 , BICH 414 , BICH 431/GENE 431 , BICH 432/GENE 432 , BICH 440 , BICH 491 , GENE 412 , GENE 419/BICH 419 , GENE 491 may not be used to satisfy this requirement.
